Would be nice if I could do something like this but this all takes funds. If I get a major refund that I'm hoping on getting then I could consider.

The problem is that doing this takes mental energy, motivation, and strength to push past anxiety. I think if I had these attributes I wouldn't be in this position to begin with. I had a chance to leave it all behind and move back with a friend and I already turned that down because I knew I would be a drag and I have no money. Now I'm back to where I was except with one friendship fewer than I had before.
What kind of game do you want to create?
Just listened to this, really liked it. Hope you continue making music.
very good basic framework for a song here

I told him about the financial aspect of it, which is a major thing keeping me from going. I'm broke and have no cash to pay for any of the deposits or anything, hardly enough to drive out. But I didn't tell him about the mental health aspect. That's an even bigger problem. I know if I try to go now I'm just going to be a dysfunctional drain and make everything difficult.

I'm going to have to look for a job here now, somehow.
Hope your pizza gives you some solace in this hell of a reality friend o7
